svg.text: Harness Engineering: How a Stateless LLM Becomes a Persistent, Evolving Agent
Each opens its surface over the chat
Triage, draft replies, send on a click
THE HARNESS — What Makes a Raw LLM into an Agentic OS
Each unit → the one place it declares
Code checks facts before the write
No approval queue, no timer expiry
context health | evolution | ToDo | skill metrics
Optional catalog + any the user adds
COMPOUND LOOP: Session -> Hooks -> Knowledge Capture -> Context -> Next Session (every session makes the next one better)
